pages.text: After snow, the mountain was very quiet. The hill behind the house rose white. Yuki watched it through the window.
"I'll look down at the village from the hilltop." Yuki tied on a scarf. "Come with me, Momo."
The hill path was silent except for Yuki's crunching feet. "Why is it so quiet?"
Snow showered from a branch. Yuki covered their ears tightly.
Yuki hugged Momo close. "I'm scared." Momo whined.
Momo slipped from Yuki's arms and climbed higher to sit on the hill.
Yuki stood alone halfway up. Momo sat far above. Yuki turned to look downhill.
Grandma held Yuki's hand in the yard. They listened quietly. Snow showered from a branch.
Yuki climbed the hill again. At the falling sound, Yuki looked toward it. "Snow is falling from there."
At last, the hilltop! "Our roof is white, too!" Momo sat beside Yuki, whose scarf fluttered in the wind.
